a: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah 3D Animated Series
d:
Swagat hai aapka Desert Safari Full Episode 31Part 02 mein – Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah 3D Animated Series ka ek dhamakedaar adventure!
Is episode mein Jethalal, Daya, Champaklal, Tappu aur Popatlal desert ke beech atak jaate hai .
Unhe milte hai 2 unth aur sab shuru karte hai ek adventurous camel ride.
Jethalal, Champaklal aur Popatlal ek camel par baithe hai, jabki Daya aur Tappu doosre par.
Masti tab shuru hoti hai jab Jethalal ka camel achanak se baghne lagta hai .
Jaise hamesha, Tappu firse sabki jaan bacha leta hai .
